enchantments.tooltip: High Spirits: You are always in good spirits, unbothered by the world around you. You are immune to Exhaustion.
Charisma +4: This item makes the wearer have more flair, granting a +4 Enhancement bonus to Charisma.
Healing Amplification: This effect amplifies all incoming positive energy healing by +14 (Competence bonus). Includes spells, potions, and other effects.
Mythic Neck Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
